description: FERC Form 1 Schedule 328, transmission of electricity for others, for one utility and report year, 1994 to date: revenue by customer (the company or public body paying for transmission service), statistical classification (FNO firm network, NF non-firm, LFP long-term firm point-to-point, SFP short-term firm point-to-point, OLF other long-term firm, and others), rate schedule, MWh received and delivered, billing demand, and demand, energy, other and total revenue in US dollars as filed. Rows sorted by revenue, total lines excluded and reported separately; top_customers_aggregated sums a customer's several lines. Answers "who paid Duke Energy Carolinas the most for transmission service in 2023". Source: FERC Form 1 as processed by Catalyst Cooperative PUDL.

classification.description: Optional statistical classification code filter, e.g. FNO, NF, LFP, SFP, OLF.

customer.description: Optional customer-name filter: part of the paying company or public body name, e.g. "NCMPA".

utility.description: FERC Form 1 respondent: a name (e.g. "PacifiCorp") or the numeric FERC respondent id (utility_id_ferc1, e.g. 303). Find ids with ferc1_find_utility.

year.description: Report year (e.g. 2023). Default: the latest year on file for the respondent.

name: ferc1_transmission_for_others
title: Ferc1 Transmission For Others
